title: Catnip is actually a powerful insect repellent
description: While famous for its effects on felines, catnip is a highly functional tool for pest control. Its primary chemical compound, nepetalactone, acts as a potent repellent against common household insects.
narration: CATNIP IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture a recreational drug for your house cat. It was closer to a potent chemical weapon against pests. This plant serves a far more practical, defensive purpose. The herb contains a terpene called nepetalactone. This compound acts as a natural insect repellent. Research shows it effectively repels mosquitoes, flies, cockroaches, and termites. A six percent lotion performs just as well as DEET. Next time you see this herb, consider the bugs it keeps away.
